correction.correct_scope: DatasetAdmission/v2 itself is a cross-trace/GRID/outcome binding gate and does not independently require or validate the VectorControlPacket preimage. However the serious dataset compiler path compile_admitted_jspace_training_dataset_v1 -> compile_jspace_bootstrap_dataset_v1 performs an additional exact packet-wire validation before emitting rows: it parses vector_control_packet_jcs_utf8, decodes under generation/basis/basis-digest/role/control-condition fences, and requires packet.packet_sha256 to equal the trace vector_control_packet_sha256. Therefore a merely invented digest cannot reach the serious dataset output through the current compiler path.
correction.remaining_architecture_question: DatasetAdmission can still be reused independently as an admission object with weaker packet semantics than the compiler boundary. Either document/encode its authority explicitly as CROSS_TRACE_BINDING_ONLY and require downstream packet validation, or centralize exact packet-preimage validation in DatasetAdmission so all consumers inherit the same fail-closed semantic boundary.
